Finding-continuity design:14 requires preservation of the settled review bundle in the committed run directory. SKILL.md Review collection specifies the invocation workspace, archives its assembled tree, and directs committing collection records at the settled boundary. run-state.md:212 defines complete assembled input collection and hashed completion; the new helper also explicitly rejects symlinks and unsafe lexical paths, but misses intermediate symlinks. Thus reachable unrelated files can be silently incorporated into the committed archive, a significant local containment risk. Scope is accessible files beneath the invocation-named directory reached through the symlink, with a valid review present; no remote attacker, privilege escalation, arbitrary whole-filesystem crawl, or actual commit was demonstrated.
